note: Public tariff schedules retrieved from the issuing port authorities' own websites and transcribed verbatim. These are PUBLIC_TARIFF rates: what the port publishes, not what any carrier pays under contract. Every rate cites the document, page, section and verbatim text it was read from. Nothing in this file is a default or an estimate.

provenance.documentHeading: Revised Vessel Related Charges with effect from 01st May 2026
provenance.fxRule: not stated in the retrieved document
provenance.validityNote: It is to clarify that since the revised rates will come into effect from midnight of 30th April 2026, all vessels which are berthed upto midnight of 30th April 2026 shall attract Port Dues and Pilotage at old rates and for berth hire beyond midnight of 30th April 2026, new rates will apply since it is on hourly basis.

schedules.title: Chennai Port Authority Indexed Scale of Rates (Gazette notification No.51 dt. 21.12.2022), with effect from 01.05.2025 to 30.04.2026

reuseEvidence.verbatim: no copyright or reuse statement found in the retrieved document
reuseEvidence.finding: A Gazette-notified Scale of Rates published by the port authority. No reuse terms stated; rates are transcribed as facts with citation and the document is not redistributed.

provenance.documentHeading: CHENNAI PORT AUTHORITY (Gazette notification No.51 dt. 21.12.2022) INDEXED SCALE OF RATES (With effect from 01.05.2025 to 30.04.2026) (excluding Estate Rental)
provenance.fxRule: (v) (a) ... All US dollar denominated tariff will be recovered in Indian Rupees after conversion of charges in US dollar terms into its equivalent Indian Rupees at the Reference rate notified by the Reserve Bank of India and in case of non-availability of RBI reference rate, the market buying rate notified by State Bank of India. ... (b) The day of entry of the vessel into the port limits shall be reckoned as the day for such conversion.
